I recently redid my home server and am now rocking the following setup:

  • 80GB Intel X25-M 50nm SSD (yeah, circa 2008)
  • 3TB Seagate ST3000DM001 HDD
  • 8 * 2TB WD RE4 HDD's (connected to Dell RAID adapter in RAID 6)

Powering the following VM's:

  • pfSense (router, 8GB VHD on the Intel SSD, 1 vCPU & 1GB of RAM)
  • Windows Server 2008 R2 (domain controller, 40GB VHD on the Corsair SSD, 2 vCPU & 2GB of RAM)
  • Windows Server 2008 R2 (file server, 50GB VHD on the 3TB HDD, 2 vCPU & 4GB of RAM - more RAM due to Crashplan, Dell Perc 6/i in PCI passthrough)
  • CentOS 7 (media grabber, 160GB VHD on the 3TB HDD, 4 vCPU & 4GB of RAM, runs Sickrage, Headphones, Plex, Transmission, connects to the Windows file server and manages all the media on it)
